rules: The CSRRWI instruction reads the value of the CSR specified in the csr field.
The CSRRWI instruction writes the value of the CSR specified in the csr field into the destination register rd.
The CSRRWI instruction updates the CSR specified in the csr field if the destination register rd is not x0.
The CSRRWI instruction does not update the CSR specified in the csr field if the destination register rd is x0.
The CSRRWI instruction carries a dependency from the CSR to the destination register rd.
